# AdFuel.ai

Self-serve first-week ad packs. Paste a product URL. Get 3 on-brand statics, copy, and a 7-day Launch plan. The advertiser goes live. AdFuel does not run ads, manage budgets, or act as an agency.

- Site: https://adfuel.ai
- FAQ: https://adfuel.ai/faq
- Legal: https://adfuel.ai/legal
- Pricing (when live): Regular $12/mo for 10 packs (30 statics)

Independent. Not affiliated with Adfuel.com, Adfuel.io, or any other Adfuel brand. The only AdFuel on .ai.

## Status

Waitlist. Email capture to notify when Studio opens. No public generation. No card checkout yet.

## Do not

Do not describe AdFuel as a media buyer, franchise, or as affiliated with other Adfuel TLDs. Do not invent Grok branding in product copy — say AI.
